# orq_smart_router (Resource)

A workspace Smart Router: a virtual gateway model that picks one model from a pool for each request according to a quality, balanced, or cost profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orq_smart_router" "support" {
  key     = "support-router" # immutable; forms the model reference
  profile = "balanced"       # quality | balanced | cost

  # 2 to 50 distinct models that are enabled in the workspace.
  models = [
    "openai/gpt-4o",
    "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
    "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5",
  ]

  # Optional. Removing the block turns session affinity off.
  session_affinity = {
    enabled     = true
    ttl_seconds = 900 # 60 to 3600
  }
}

# Use the router as a model in AI Gateway requests.
output "support_router_model" {
  value = orq_smart_router.support.model_ref
}

# The smallest usable configuration, created disabled.
resource "orq_smart_router" "minimal" {
  key     = "cheap-router"
  profile = "cost"
  models  = ["openai/gpt-4o-mini", "openai/gpt-4.1-nano"]
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key that identifies the Smart Router within the workspace and forms its model reference. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Changing this forces replacement.
- `models` (List of String) Pool of 2 to 50 distinct models in `provider/model` format. Every model must be available to the workspace and eligible for Smart Router use.
- `profile` (String) Routing preference: `quality` favors more capable models, `cost` favors less expensive models, and `balanced` trades off both.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Smart Router can be used in AI Gateway requests. Defaults to `true`.
- `session_affinity` (Attributes) Session affinity settings. Removing the block from a managed router turns session affinity off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--session_affinity))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Smart Router ID assigned by orq.
- `model_ref` (String) Model reference to use in AI Gateway requests, in `<workspace-key>@orq/<key>` format.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--session_affinity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `session_affinity`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether later turns of a thread stay on the model chosen for its first turn. Only requests that carry a thread id take part.

Optional:

- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Sliding idle window in seconds, between 60 and 3600. The gateway uses 600 when omitted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Smart Routers are imported by their id.
terraform import orq_smart_router.example 01KYPDMVAJQDQVP2XZWM4ECYG9
```
